text:
marie: Quick heads up — running a small lighthouse run on the pricing page: calculator + compact FAQ swap. Goal: reduce support tickets about tier boundaries and increase Dedicated trials.
sam: Nice. What's the hypothesis and primary metric?
marie: Hypothesis: a guided calculator + inline FAQ will increase trial starts from pricing by 12% and drop 'which tier' CS tickets by 30%.
aj: For the guided calc UI I propose two microcopy variants: 'cost-first' (show monthly est) vs 'value-first' (show recommended tier). I'll drop comps in #design.
taylor: Need events. Minimal tracking: calculator.open, calculator.submit, faq.expand, trial.click, tier-recommendation.view. Also capture cohort via ?exp=pack-calc-lh
(taylor continues): Example payloads:
```
event: "pricing.calculator.submit"
props: {source: "pricing_page", variant: "value-first", est_monthly: 240}
```
nick: Backend note: current server-side calc uses the old rate table. If we show different estimates (bundle discounts) we need a 2-line change in pricing-service. I can patch but need the final formula by EOD.
ella: Can we also add a short FAQ item for 'data residency & Dedicated' — CS gets that question a lot when customers read packaging.
marie: Yes — add a FAQ tile: "Does Dedicated include private deployments?" short answer + link to docs.
sam: For copy: short, active verbs. Two CTA labels to test: "Start Dedicated trial" vs "Try Dedicated (no credit card)". Preference poll?
aj: Love the second CTA — more explicit.
pricing-bot: deploy preview: https://deploy.preview/pricing/pack-calc-lh (staging)
sam: Looks good. I'll write microcopy drafts by noon.
taylor: I'll wire the tracking and create the Segment source + amplitude chart. Please use event names exactly as above.
nick: I'll open PR for pricing-service formula; tagging @marie for approval.
marie: Cool — sync 2pm to review comps + analytics. If anyone can't make, drop notes below. :thumbsup:
